# BPM / Laws+ compatibility patch - common/laws
# Generated by tools/build.py. Do not rename: the zzzzzzzzzz_ prefix keeps
# these files last in the ASCII order the game resolves conflicts by.

# law_freedom_of_conscience
REPLACE:law_freedom_of_conscience = {
	group = lawgroup_church_and_state
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/freedom_of_conscience.dds"
	progressiveness = 0
	unlocking_technologies = {
		rationalism
	}
	disallowing_laws = {
		law_theocracy
	}
	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:atheist
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
			}
			set_state_religion = root.country_definition.religion
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = antireligious_policies
			}
			remove_modifier = antireligious_policies
		}
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
	}
	modifier = {
		country_clergymen_pol_str_mult = 0.25
		country_authority_add = 100
		country_state_religion_wages_mult = 0.05
		country_non_state_religion_wages_mult = -0.05
		country_acceptance_state_religion_add = 20
		country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_add = 15
		country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_group_add = 5
		country_acceptance_no_shared_religious_trait_add = 0
		country_allow_conversion_violent_hostility_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_second_rate_citizen_bool = no
		country_allow_conversion_full_acceptance_bool = no
	}
	can_impose = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_church_and_state_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes
			}
			add = 750
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_sick_man_education
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:law_millet_system = { # Ottoman Empire
	group = lawgroup_church_and_state
	parent = law_state_religion
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/people_of_the_book.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	requires_law_or = {
		law_theocracy
		law_monarchy
		law_chiefdom
	}
	is_visible = {
		c:TUR ?= this
	}
	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:atheist
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
			}
			set_state_religion = root.country_definition.religion
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = antireligious_policies
			}
			remove_modifier = antireligious_policies
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					c:TUR ?= this
					country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni
				}
			}
			deactivate_law = law_type:law_millet_system
			activate_law = law_type:law_state_religion
		}
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
	}
	modifier = {
		country_clergymen_pol_str_mult = 0.5
		country_authority_add = 200
		state_conversion_mult = -0.50
		state_conscription_rate_mult = -0.4
		country_acceptance_state_religion_add = 25
		country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_add = 10
		country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_group_add = 10
		country_acceptance_no_shared_religious_trait_add = -25
		country_allow_conversion_violent_hostility_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_full_acceptance_bool = yes
	}
	tax_modifier_very_low = {
		tax_heathen_add = 0.4
	}
	tax_modifier_low = {
		tax_heathen_add = 0.45
	}
	tax_modifier_medium = {
		tax_heathen_add = 0.5
	}
	tax_modifier_high = {
		tax_heathen_add = 0.55
	}
	tax_modifier_very_high = {
		tax_heathen_add = 0.6
	}
	can_impose = {
		always = no
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		exists = ruler
		ruler = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes
			}
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
		value = 0
	}
}

# law_multicultural
REPLACE:law_multicultural = {
	group = lawgroup_citizenship
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/multicultural.dds"
	progressiveness = 75
	unlocking_laws = {
		law_slavery_banned
	}
	unlocking_technologies = {
		human_rights
	}
	on_enact = {
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
			}
			custom_tooltip = fervor_effects_ld_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = modifier_polish_organic_statute
			}
			remove_modifier = modifier_polish_organic_statute
		}
	}
	can_impose = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_citizenship_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	modifier = {

		country_acceptance_shared_heritage_trait_group_add = 50

		country_acceptance_shared_language_trait_add = 50
		country_acceptance_shared_language_trait_group_add = 30

		country_acceptance_shared_tradition_trait_add = 10
		country_acceptance_no_shared_tradition_trait_add = 0
		country_primary_culture_fervor_from_laws_add = -10
	}
	acceptance_modifier = {
		country_allow_voting_violent_hostility_bool = yes
		country_allow_voting_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
		country_allow_voting_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_allow_voting_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
		country_allow_voting_full_acceptance_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
		country_allow_assimilation_full_acceptance_bool = yes
		country_wage_violent_hostility_mult = -0.2
		country_wage_cultural_erasure_mult = -0.1
		country_wage_open_prejudice_mult = -0.05
		country_disallow_military_work_violent_hostility_bool = no
		country_disallow_military_work_cultural_erasure_bool = no
		country_disallow_military_work_open_prejudice_bool = no
		country_disallow_military_work_second_rate_citizen_bool = no

		value = 0

			limit = {
				ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes
			}
			add = 750

			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_tp_pool_cultural_dominance
				scope:law.type.progressiveness > active_law:lawgroup_citizenship.type.progressiveness
			}
			add = -750

			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = ai_ukraine_renaissance_repress
					has_variable = ai_belarus_renaissance_repress
				}
			}
			add = -750
		}
	}
	is_visible = {

# law_sakoku
REPLACE:law_sakoku = {
	group = lawgroup_trade_policy
	parent = law_isolationism
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/sakoku.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	requires_law_or = {
		law_traditionalism
	}
	is_visible = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
		any_scope_state = {
			state_region = s:STATE_KYUSHU
			is_largest_state_in_region = yes
		}
		has_law = law_type:law_sakoku
	}
	modifier = {
		country_authority_mult = 0.25
		country_influence_mult = -0.50
		country_tech_spread_mult = -0.20
		state_trade_capacity_mult = -0.75
		state_tariff_import_add = 0.50
		state_tariff_export_add = 0.50
		state_subvention_export_add = 0.20
		state_subvention_import_add = 0.20
		country_leverage_resistance_mult = 0.75
		country_disallow_trade_outside_kyushu_bool = yes
		state_trade_center_max_limit_add = 5
		country_disallow_aggressive_plays_bool = yes
		country_rigidity_baseline_add = 10
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		OR = {
			has_journal_entry = je_sakoku
			ruler = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_game_started = yes
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_closed_borders
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = internal_controls_strengthened_tt
			activate_law = law_type:law_closed_borders
		}
	}
	on_deactivate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_closed_borders
			}
			custom_tooltip = internal_controls_relaxed_tt
			activate_law = law_type:law_migration_controls
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes
			}
			add = 750
		}
	}
}

# law_state_religion
REPLACE:law_state_religion = {
	group = lawgroup_church_and_state
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/state_religion.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	is_visible = {
		NOR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_millet_system
			has_law = law_type:law_people_of_the_book
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:atheist
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
			}
			set_state_religion = root.country_definition.religion
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = antireligious_policies
			}
			remove_modifier = antireligious_policies
		}
		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes
	}
	modifier = {
		country_clergymen_pol_str_mult = 0.5
		country_authority_add = 200
		country_state_religion_wages_mult = 0.1
		country_non_state_religion_wages_mult = -0.1
		country_acceptance_state_religion_add = 25
		country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_add = 0
		country_acceptance_shared_religious_trait_group_add = -10
		country_acceptance_no_shared_religious_trait_add = -25
		country_allow_conversion_violent_hostility_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_cultural_erasure_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_open_prejudice_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_second_rate_citizen_bool = yes
		country_allow_conversion_full_acceptance_bool = yes
	}
	can_impose = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_church_and_state_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law
				}
			}
			can_impose_law_default = yes
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		exists = ruler
		ruler = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes
			}
			add = 750
		}
	}
	ai_impose_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_state_religion
				power_bloc ?= {
					has_identity = identity:identity_religious
				}
				religion = scope:target_country.religion
			}
			add = base_impose_law_weight
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_country = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_freedom_of_conscience
					}
				}
				multiply = 2
			}
			else = {
				multiply = 5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target_country = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_plantations
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_military
						has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_universities
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

# law_total_separation
REPLACE:law_total_separation = {
	group = lawgroup_church_and_state
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/total_separation.dds"
	progressiveness = 50
	unlocking_technologies = {

	}

		law_theocracy
	}
	is_visible = {

		}
	}
	can_enact = {
		OR = {
			is_power_bloc_leader = no

				NOT = {
					has_identity = identity:identity_religious
				}
			}
		}
	}

		if = {
			limit = {

				has_modifier = antireligious_policies

		country_allow_conversion_cultural_erasure_bool = no
		country_allow_conversion_open_prejudice_bool = no
		country_allow_conversion_second_rate_citizen_bool = no
		country_allow_conversion_full_acceptance_bool = no

	can_impose = {

			AND = {
				is_in_same_power_bloc = scope:target_country
				AND = {
					modifier:country_can_impose_same_lawgroup_church_and_state_in_power_bloc_bool = yes
					has_law = scope:law

			can_impose_law_default = yes
